decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits in the firm's core cultured dairy offer and performed above aspiration, so there is little shortfall to trigger dropping it, even though it was less visible after 2019.

The Abendbrotkäse was a flagship, and that strategic commitment plus slack from a growing organic market favour keeping it, though it disappeared from the website after 2019 and flavoured cheeses carry some risk of rotation.
The semi-hard cheese wheel uses existing milk supply and processes at low cost and likely meets aspiration, so there is no reason to start search for other uses of its resources.
Weaker variants of the spicy cheese line may be pruned after it fell from view, but the line as a whole is likely kept as part of the expanded cheese range.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the cheese range at little extra cost, and with no clear shortfall reported, management would carry it a while longer despite its low visibility.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a niche item that has not been visible since 2018 and likely falls short of sales aspirations, so its resources are better redirected to core products.
